research_history_boundary.claim: exact-policy mechanical freeze, not a globally pristine market holdout; 2024+ and live forward remain final generalization tests

novelty_boundary.economic_axis: an exceptional single-bar impulse is followed by a fixed 30-minute quiet compression and traded only after a separate 15-minute window breaks the box with same-direction flow and range reacceleration

source_contract.source: official Binance USD-M archives and funding API backfill
source_contract.missing_bar_policy: fail closed; never fill a missing execution bar

causal_feature_contract.shock_threshold: abs(r[j]) >= max(40bp, strictly-prior rolling q99.5 of abs(r) over 8,640 clean observations with at least 2,016 prior observations)
causal_feature_contract.shock_confirmation: abs(r[j])/sigma72_pre[j] >= 4; d*taker_imbalance[j]>=0.15; quote_volume[j]>=strictly-prior rolling median quote volume
causal_feature_contract.compression_window: completed bars j+1 through j+6 inclusive
causal_feature_contract.adverse_box: maximum adverse box excursion from close[j] <=0.30*abs(r[j])
causal_feature_contract.reacceleration_window: completed bars j+7 through j+9 inclusive
causal_feature_contract.reacceleration: directional close-to-close return >=max(15bp,0.30*box_width); close[j+9] clears the directional box edge by >=5bp; directional three-bar flow >=max(0.10, prior q70 absolute three-bar flow); directional flow minus compression flow >=0.10; mean true range over j+7:j+9 >=1.50 times mean true range over j+1:j+6
causal_feature_contract.availability: the signal becomes known only after bar j+9 is complete; all rolling baselines exclude their current observation

execution_contract.entry: next BTCUSDT perpetual open at j+10
execution_contract.exit: scheduled open 48 five-minute bars after entry
execution_contract.cagr: full wall-clock split including idle cash
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM, favorable-before-adverse held OHLC, funding, entry/exit/hypothetical-liquidation costs

controls.direction_flip: primary clock with opposite side; diagnostic only and never a repair
controls.immediate_shock: same frozen shock events entered at j+1 without compression or trigger
controls.compression_without_flow: same shock/compression/breakout but remove all flow requirements
controls.without_compression: same shock and reacceleration requirements with compression gates removed
controls.without_range: same shock/compression/flow requirements with breakout and range gates removed
controls.shock_time_shift_one_day: move the complete primary event geometry exactly 288 bars earlier
controls.mechanism_rejection_rule: reject DACC-48 if no-compression, no-flow, no-range, or one-day-shift control independently passes every primary performance gate

rejection_contract: any support, performance, mechanism, or orthogonality failure rejects DACC-48 without changing its q99.5, windows, ratios, flow floor, direction, entry delay, hold, cost, or performance threshold
